questions: Have you had previous episodes that were very similar to this one?
Did the episode begin abruptly, without a gradual awakening?
Did the episode last less than two minutes?
Did you remain completely unaware of your surroundings during the episode?
Were you unable to respond when someone spoke to or touched you?
Do you remember anything that happened during the episode?
Were you confused or unusually sleepy for more than 10 minutes afterward?
Have these episodes ever occurred more than once in the same night?
Do the episodes usually occur at about the same time after falling asleep?
Do you regularly act out dreams, sleepwalk, or have night terrors?
Have you bitten the side of your tongue during or after an episode?
Did you lose control of your bladder during this episode?
Did you sustain an injury during the episode?
Did you have a severe headache or generalized muscle soreness afterward?
Have you ever had a seizure while awake?
Have you ever been diagnosed with epilepsy?
Is there a family history of epilepsy or unexplained sudden death?
Have you recently missed sleep or had substantial sleep deprivation?
Have you recently used alcohol, recreational drugs, or a new medication?
Have you had fever, head injury, or another acute illness recently?
